watch.name: Rakuten
watch.what: Cashback shopping portal that pays approval bonuses on partner issuers' credit cards.
watch.why_fit: Shows a third-party portal acting as an acquisition channel for card issuers, which Wells Fargo could use or counter.

history.note: Added approval bonuses on three Citi cards this week: $50 cashback or up to 5,000 Bilt points.

items.title: Rakuten New Member Bonus: $50 Referral Offer & How To Maximize It
items.why: Benchmark this low-cost two-sided referral loop against our own card referral and member-get-member offers.
items.summary_ai: Rakuten's $50 referral bonus runs through year-end 2026, paying both referrer and new member plus card points.
items.take: Benchmark this low-cost two-sided referral loop against our own card referral and member-get-member offers.
